topologyPolicy.decision: Use route groups for walked official route topology and connections for transfers between route entries.

routeGroupKinds.mainline: Primary continuous official section chain for the selected trail model.
routeGroupKinds.branch: Official alternate or side branch that can be hiked as trail, but should not be silently merged into the mainline.
routeGroupKinds.access: Official or strongly supported approach route to/from public transport, village, trailhead or another trail.
routeGroupKinds.connector: Walked link between route groups or nearby route sections where it is part of the trail model.

topologyPolicy.connectionsUse: Use connections.json-style records for non-section transfers or continuity records between sections: ferry, bus, road transfer, rowboat, short walk transfer, same-island continuity, or mode none for a known gap with no usable transfer geometry.
topologyPolicy.officialRowboatRule: If a rowboat crossing is an official route entry in its own right, model it as a section route with strong warnings. Otherwise model it as a rowboat connection or access/side metadata.

importOrder.name: Normalize route geometry first
importOrder.notes: Resolve stage 1 variants, stage 2 branches, stages 3-5 segment assembly/reversal, stage 7 mainline/access split and stage 8 two child GPX components plus connectors.

importOrder.name: Apply protected-area rule scoping after geometry
importOrder.notes: Run boundary overlays before attaching Tiveden, Granvik/Håketjärnarna, Stora Röå/Röå alsumpskog, Hjoåns dalgång, Hökensås/Hyltan, Gagnån or Mullsjö/Stråken area rules.

importOrder.name: Import only high-confidence facilities
importOrder.notes: Import facilities with source-backed coordinates and clear legal/currentness status. Keep Hjoåns dalgång fireplace, Hållsdammsbäcken fireplace/camping, Rödåkra/line 405, natural water, optional businesses and unverified subfacilities pending or suppressed.

importOrder.name: Recheck volatile sources immediately before runtime import
importOrder.notes: Transit schedules, fire bans, SMHI fire risk, forestry notices, business hours, bathing-water status, water reliability and shelter maintenance should be checked near the actual import date.

decisionsApplied.decision: Approve candidate-only route/connector geometry prototype scope: stage variants and child components may be normalized under research artifacts only; runtime source data remains untouched.

routeGroups.notes: Stage 1 primary/alternate variants must remain explicit during geometry normalization.
Stage 2 direct line is primary; Skackastugan remains an alternate branch.

connections.importPolicy: Treat Gagnån as the mainline handoff and Fagerhult as access/connector metadata unless final geometry proves otherwise.
Keep stage 8 child GPX components under one section and normalize Furusjö-Mullsjö Hotell direction to the official endpoint.

remainingGeometryWork: Implement stage 1 variants, stage 2 alternate, stages 3-5 assembly/reversal, stage 7 access split and stage 8 child components before runtime route import.
Run protected-area overlays against the final normalized geometry.
